snippet.title: Canvas City - Announcement Trailer 2
snippet.description:
Canvas City is a turn-based tactics RPG of rebellion on roller skates. Lead a crew of skaters and street artists rising up against an oppressive regime. Each map is a battleground and a canvas, where your actions shift control, leave your mark, and shape the city’s future.

What can you expect from Canvas City?
-📖 An original story and setting in a campaign packed with rival crews, mysterious figures, and evolving characters.
✨ Over 80 unique abilities & tricks to master
🛼 12 recruitable characters to customize your team
✅ Clear bonus objectives for rewards and build your garage, your crew’s hub for loadouts, backstories, and pre-mission planning.
🔄 Replay and revisit completed levels to refine your strategy, maximize your score, and earn the highest possible rank on every stage.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3226830/Canvas_City/
